text: Found it: the API manager card. Kalshi and Polymarket showed 'standby' only because the card counted fetches, and these two arrive by socket/memory so no fetch is counted. They were feeding 1918 and 910 fair-odds lines (82 and 2 only they priced), so they were working. Fixed: a feed that prices lines now shows 'active'. It ships in the next release. Separately: ParlayAPI is failing (HTTP 502 from their side, 0% answers); OddsPapi and Unabated are off in your switches.
